meta.method: Node regex scan of comment-stripped source (read-only); cross-checked with grep: style={{ 254+538+43=835; px/rem/em literals 855 by grep -o. Imports parsed per file to separate GDS-package components (incl. components/gds/ClientWrappers and CameraSemanticButton, which only re-export GDS), Mantine primitives (components/gds/PublicPrimitives barrel or @mantine/core) and camera composites (components/admin|gds, relative imports). Alias-aware (DataToolbar as GdsDataToolbar).

fieldNotes.gdsColourTokens: uses of var(--gds-<name>) where <name> is a colour role GDS defines
fieldNotes.gdsPhantomTokens: var(--gds-*) uses whose name no GDS version defines
fieldNotes.rawLayoutTags: div, span, p, ul, label, input, h1-h4
fieldNotes.gdsComponents: JSX uses of components imported from @sovereignsquad/gds-core|admin|theme (+ClientWrappers, CameraSemanticButton)
fieldNotes.mantinePrimitives: JSX uses of names imported from components/gds/PublicPrimitives or @mantine/core
fieldNotes.pxRemLiterals: literals like 1rem, 0.75rem, 280px, 1px anywhere in code (not comments)

meta.verdictRule: hardcoded: inlineStyles>=10 OR gdsPhantomTokens>=5 OR rawLayoutTags>=20. conforms: inlineStyles<=2 AND gdsPhantomTokens=0 AND rawLayoutTags<=4 AND mantinePrimitives<=gdsComponents AND pxRemLiterals<=2 (28 of the 54 conforming files have no UI of their own: redirects, wrappers). Everything else: mixed. Verdict is per file; shared shells hide debt (see pageAggregates).

components.name: GdsStack
components.does: Vertical flex stack; gap token none|xs|sm|md|lg|xl|2xl (default md), align, padding, maxWidth, responsive per breakpoint. Replaces display:grid;gap divs.

components.name: GdsInline
components.does: Horizontal wrapping flex row; gap default sm, align default center, per-breakpoint values.

components.name: GdsCluster
components.does: GdsInline preset that pushes children apart (justify between): toolbar and header rows.

components.name: GdsGrid
components.does: Equal-width CSS grid; columns number or auto-fit/auto-fill with minColumnWidth token (xs..xl, aside 18rem, content 42rem, narrow 56rem, page 72rem, wide 88rem, full); responsive per breakpoint. Replaces GRID/COLUMNS constants and columnCount.

components.name: GdsColumnGrid / GdsColumnGridItem
components.does: 12-track column grid with items that span N tracks per breakpoint (replaces SimpleGrid + gridColumn:span 2).

components.name: GdsSplit
components.does: Two columns with fixed ratio (1:1, 2:1, 1:2, 3:2, 2:3) that collapse to one column below a breakpoint (default md).

components.name: GdsSidebar
components.does: Fixed-width side column plus content that collapses to one column below a breakpoint.

components.name: GdsContainer
components.does: Centred max-width page wrapper (size default page = 72rem, padding md/lg).

components.name: GdsBox / GdsBleed
components.does: Token-driven layout box (display, padding, margin, maxWidth) and a full-bleed wrapper with negative inline margins.

components.name: GdsSafeBox / GdsMediaFrame / GdsOverflowFrame / GdsResponsiveVisibility
components.does: Governed replacements for ad-hoc style objects: token-only safeStyle box, fixed-aspect media frame with object-fit, governed scroll/overflow frame, per-breakpoint show/hide.

components.name: PageTitle / SectionTitle / CardTitle
components.does: Heading roles: h1-size page title, h2-size section title, h4-size card title (semantic h1/h2/h3). Replace raw h1-h4 and Mantine Title.

components.name: BodyText / MetadataText / LabelText / InlineText
components.does: Text roles: body p (sm), secondary metadata span (xs, dimmed), semibold label span (sm), inheriting inline span. Replace Mantine Text, c="dimmed" and color:var(--gds-color-muted).

components.name: SectionPanel
components.does: Titled content section: eyebrow, title, description, header action, tone default|supporting|warning|critical, divided. The standard panel for dashboards, detail pages and settings; documented as the replacement for ad-hoc card-plus-title markup.

components.name: AccentPanel

components.name: InfoCard / MetricCard / StatsStrip

components.name: MediaPreviewCard

Camera uses it only through its adapter components/media/MediaPreviewCard.tsx (5 preview spots) and indirectly through AdminResourceManager.

components.name: ListingCard

gdsVarReferencesInAdmin.note: 97% of var(--gds-*) references in admin code point at names GDS never defined (--gds-color-muted 107, --gds-color-border 85, --gds-color-surface-muted 7, --gds-color-surface 6, --gds-color-danger 2, --gds-shadow-lg 2, --gds-space-2 2, --gds-shadow-xl 1, --gds-color-accent 1). A declaration whose variable is undefined is invalid at computed-value time: border:1px solid var(--gds-color-border) renders NO border, color:var(--gds-color-muted) inherits the parent colour (not dimmed), background:var(--gds-color-surface) is transparent, box-shadow is none. Derived from CSS rules and the package sources; not yet confirmed in a browser.

unusedTokens.note: The only --gds-* custom properties with a valid name that admin code reads: --gds-border-card x2, --gds-overlay-scrim x2, --gds-overlay-surface x2, --gds-radius-lg x1 (with fallback), all inside two hand-rolled modals. Tokens whose name is valid but which camera's lane does not emit at :root (space, radius, font-size, weight, line-height, elevation, control-height) would resolve to nothing; reach them through component props (GdsStack gap, SectionPanel) or --mantine-* aliases.
